project.name: backend-parent
project.description: Alfred's backend - serves proxy/logs/calls.log over a small HTTP API. One Maven module per vertical slice (backend-calls, backend-comments, backend-export), each internally hexagonal (domain/application/adapter packages). A slice can only be reached through its own module boundary - there is no way to accidentally import another slice's internals, since Maven simply won't put it on the classpath unless declared as a dependency. backend-architecture-test enforces the domain/application/ adapter dependency direction within each slice via ArchUnit.
